short_description: Compare one service’s uptime and response latency before and after a release on your BUSY Bar.
description: Monitor a group of sites, Bitrise and Jenkins, or compare one service before and after a release. Compare one service’s uptime and response latency before and after a release on your BUSY Bar. Set Service health URL to a small health endpoint you operate. The app samples it at launch and every 30 seconds while open. Click for a manual probe. The wheel switches between availability and latency.
